newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ says to watch effect of forex rates on prices.
newsitem.headline: BOJ says to watch effect of forex rates on prices.

text.p: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) will continue to watch the effect exchange rates have on domestic prices in Japan, a central bank official told a news conference on Tuesday.
The official said import prices had been rising rather sharply due to the weakening of the yen and added that the rise was a factor in halting the declining trend in domestic prices.
"Although domestic prices do not look as though they will rise in the near term, we will continue to watch the rise in import prices carefully."
He said the central bank would continue to pay close attention to the effect of currency movements on import prices.
He added that it was important for foreign exchange rates to stabilise to allow firms to make strategic plans.
The official said that although the weakening of the yen had led to a rise in Japanese exports and a subsequent rise in production, the yen"s weakness would not be wholly welcomed by Japanese firms.

He said many Japanese manufacturers had shifted production overseas and the yen"s weakness would be a burden to them as it would lead to a rise in prices of goods imported from overseas production centres.
